description: This file defines the NetworkMonitorClient class, which acts as a client for interacting with the Amazon CloudWatch Network Monitor service. It provides method signatures for various monitor and probe management operations, including creation, deletion, retrieval, listing, tagging, and updating of resources, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: NetworkMonitorClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the Amazon CloudWatch Network Monitor service, providing methods for managing monitors and probes.

methods.name: createMonitor
methods.description: Creates a new Network Monitor with specified arguments.

methods.name: createMonitorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Network Monitor.

methods.name: createProbe
methods.description: Creates a new probe with specified arguments.

methods.name: deleteMonitorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an existing network monitor.

methods.name: getMonitor
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific monitor.

methods.name: getMonitorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific monitor.

methods.name: getProbe
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific probe.

methods.name: getProbeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific probe.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
